sources.title: Federal Decree-Law No. (3) of 2003 Regulating Telecommunications (as amended)
sources.notes: Official English translation on the UAE legislation portal (direct fetch 403 Cloudflare; text via Jina reader). Consolidated text as shown on the portal. The TDRA consolidated English print (https://tdra.gov.ae/-/media/About/Legal-References/LAW/LAW-English/Final-TDRA-telecom-law_Final_english_o-02-07-2022--W-OUT-Bleed.ashx, sha256 de1ab5b117b7dedac89cbbf5e499d2c532e2488a191aa3ebd6624f252fba9585) is image-only and was not used. Contains embedded amending text with its own "Article (25)/(31)/(33)/(47)" headings (Etisalat corporation law amendments) inside the law; do not confuse with Arts 25-47 of the Decree-Law. Date is year of issue only (day not verified).

sources.title: Decision of the Supreme Committee for the Supervision of the Telecommunications Sector No. (3) of 2004 Issuing the Executive Order of Federal Law by Decree No. 3 of 2003
sources.issuer: Supreme Committee for the Supervision of the Telecommunications Sector
sources.notes: Full 75-article Executive Order (28 pp, TRA print, "THE ARABIC VERSION OF THE EXECUTIVE ORDER SHALL PREVAIL"). Dated 14 Sha'ban 1425H / 28 September 2004 in the text. The other TDRA file "Resolution No (3) of 2004 Issuing the Executive Order" (research/kb-raw/execorder.pdf, sha256 c6cfc1b6e2e13345109a1b3f238c385eb1dc0777f41a9afa04d7c1368d392368) is a 1-page scanned cover showing only Article One and Article Seventy Five, dated 28/12/2004; not used. Three two-column definitions in Art 1 were re-ordered into term-then-definition reading order.

sources.title: Public Telecommunications Licence No. 2/2026 (e&)
sources.notes: Effective 2026-08-09 to 2046-08-08; replaces Licence 1/2006. Bilingual EN/AR; text layer keeps the English column only (Art 16.7: the Arabic version is binding, the English is official guidance). Used as the licence template for the fictional operator. The du Licence 3/2026 uses the same template and is deliberately excluded (see uae-notes.md). Art 2.1.3 is redacted "[Confidential]" in the public copy.

sources.title: Consumer Protection Regulations, Version 2.0
sources.notes: Byte-identical to the organiser dataset copy 3.2_TDRA_Consumer_Protection_Regulations_v2.pdf. Footnote markers appear inline as numbers (e.g. "prior consent 35 before"); footnote texts are kept as separate lines.

sources.title: Cabinet Resolution No. (56) of 2024 Concerning the Telemarketing Regulations
sources.notes: English version published on u.ae. In force 60 days after Official Gazette publication (Art 11). Art 1 definition table rebuilt as "Term : definition" lines. Penalties are in Cabinet Resolution 57/2024 (not ingested).

sources.title: TDRA Board Renews Telecom Licences of Both Operators for Another 20 Years (press release)
sources.notes: Official regulator press release; statement of policy intent, not an obligation. Text layer is the article body only (page navigation and feedback widgets removed). Dynamic HTML: a re-fetch will not reproduce the sha256. Marked SECONDARY (official announcement, not an instrument) so the gate never accepts it as evidence for an obligation. Status VERIFIED: official government announcement read in full; non-binding (binding=false).

sources.title: Federal Decree by Law No. (45) of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data
sources.notes: Official English translation on the UAE legislation portal (direct fetch 403; via Jina). Date is entry into force (Art 31). Executive Regulations still not issued as of June 2026 (Morgan Lewis LawFlash 2026-06-15, see UAE-FAAID-2026), so the Art 9 notification period is undefined. Applies onshore; excludes free zones with own data law (Art 2(2)(g)). Organiser copies checked: "Federal Decree Law No 45 of 2021 on Personal Data Protection.pdf" is Arabic only; 2.1_PDPL_Federal_Decree-Law_45_of_2021.pdf is an unofficial English/Japanese translation with different wording (substance of Arts 2, 9, 18 matches). Art 2(1) list items appear on the portal as "2.", "b.", "c." (verbatim).

sources.title: The UAE Charter for the Development & Use of Artificial Intelligence
sources.notes: Raw is the organiser dataset copy (1.2_UAE_AI_Charter_2024.pdf): PDF title "UAEAI-Methaq-EN2", footer AI.GOV.AE, dated July 2024, 12 principles. The official URL returns 403 (Cloudflare) from here, so the sha256 is of the organiser copy, not re-downloaded. Broken "Th"/"ff" ligature glyphs were restored to letters.

sources.title: AI Ethics: Principles & Guidelines
sources.notes: Raw is the organiser dataset copy ("MOCAI AI Ethics.pdf", Dec 2022, 8 principles); the official URL now returns 404 and no current u.ae asset URL was found, so the sha256 is of the organiser copy. Self-described as non-binding guidelines. Two-page spreads were split into left/right pages for reading order; some guideline numbers are duplicated in the source (e.g. two "3.1.2.4").

sources.title: UAE National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence 2031
sources.issuer: UAE Government / Minister of State for Artificial Intelligence
sources.notes: Raw is the organiser dataset copy ("UAE National Strategy for AI 2031.pdf", PDF created 2018-11-26); official u.ae path now 404, sha256 is of the organiser copy. Strategy document, not an obligation. Charts and infographics extract as fragments.

sources.title: UAE Cabinet, chaired by Mohammed bin Rashid, approves federal framework for Agentic AI Project implementation (Government of Dubai Media Office news release)
sources.issuer: Government of Dubai Media Office (UAE Cabinet meeting readout)
sources.notes: Official government announcement of Cabinet decisions; the framework text itself is not published. Covers federal government services and operations (50% to Agentic AI within two years), not telecom operators. Same article body as the organiser files 1.3_..._Agentic_AI_80k.html (also saved as 9.1, 13.2 and 14.2). Dynamic HTML: re-fetch will not reproduce the sha256. Marked SECONDARY (official announcement, not an instrument) so the gate never accepts it as evidence for an obligation. Status VERIFIED: official government announcement read in full; non-binding (binding=false).

sources.title: UAE National Cybersecurity Strategy (2019)
sources.notes: Downloaded from TDRA on 2026-10-05; byte-identical to organiser 4.1_UAE_National_Cybersecurity_Strategy_2019.pdf. A 28-slide presentation (5 pillars, ~60 initiatives), so the text layer is slide fragments. Pre-dates the Cyber Security Council's current policies; context only.

sources.title: Business Continuity Management Standard and Guide, AE/HSC/NCEMA 7000:2012, Version 1
sources.notes: Raw is the organiser dataset copy 5.1b_NCEMA_7000_2012_BCM_Standard_v1.pdf (official NCEMA standard, 116 pp). Superseded by later editions (2015, 2021); the 2021 edition could not be obtained (ncema.gov.ae times out from here and via Jina; the organiser 5.1 "2021" file is a third-party CORE Consulting self-assessment checklist, not the standard). url is the NCEMA publications page; the direct file URL for this edition was not verified. Running headers "Part 1/2/3" removed.

sources.title: UAE Establishes Federal Authority for Artificial Intelligence and Data (Morgan Lewis LawFlash)
sources.notes: Law-firm summary of the 2026-06-14 announcement; primary decree or WAM release not found. Also the source for "PDPL Implementing Regulations have still not been issued". Dynamic HTML: re-fetch will not reproduce the sha256.

sources.title: Du calling services back after disruption in Dubai and Abu Dhabi (The National)
sources.notes: Press report. Article body only. Does not mention 999/emergency calls or any TDRA statement. Dynamic HTML.

sources.notes: Press report of a Dubai Court of Cassation judgment (March 2022); the judgment itself was not obtained. Article body only; "Recommended" and "Also read" widgets removed. Dynamic HTML.

sources.title: Here's why UAE bank customers will no longer receive OTPs via texts and emails (The National)
sources.notes: Press report. States CBUAE "has not issued an official notice particularly addressing the cancellation of OTP through SMS or email"; a banker describes a May 2025 CBUAE circular. The article does not name a notice number or a 2026-03-31 deadline. Image captions removed. Dynamic HTML.
